Name: Asset Bridge
Author: Nikanor24
Description:
[b]AssetBridge[/b] lets mods [b]load textures directly from another mod’s folder[/b].
It’s a lightweight framework designed to reduce sprite conflicts and avoid redundant copies of the same files.

With AssetBridge, you can create [b]logical assets[/b] (like Characters/NpcName_anything) that are automatically linked to sprites in another mod.

This is ideal for animation frameworks, conditional texture swaps, or simply sharing art assets between packs.

How It Works

[list=1]
[*][b]AssetBridge[/b] creates a virtual data asset called AssetBridges. Content Patcher can patch it with EditData to define links between logical assets and the actual PNG files in other mods.

[*]When the game or another mod requests an asset, AssetBridge intercepts the request, locates the linked file in the target mod, and serves it automatically.
[/list]

In you manifest.json add a new dependency:
[code]﻿"Dependencies": [
﻿{ "UniqueID": "Nikanor.AssetBridge", "IsRequired": true }
],
[/code]
In you content.json: 
[code]﻿{
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "AssetBridges",
      "Entries": {
        "Characters/NpcName": "TargetUniqueID/path inside their mod/file name.png"
      }
}
[/code]
Let’s say you want to use Alex’s sprites from the mod [b]Seasonal Cute Characters[/b] (Poltergeister.SeasonalCuteCharacters) and load them into new logical assets for use in another pack or animation.

Here’s what your Content Patcher configuration would look like:

[code]﻿﻿{
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "AssetBridges",
      "Entries": {
       "Characters/Alex_Example": "Poltergeister.SeasonalCuteCharacters/assets/Characters/Alex/Alex_Summer.png",
﻿ ﻿"Portraits/Alex_Example": "Poltergeister.SeasonalCuteCharacters/assets/Portraits/Alex/Alex_Summer.png"
      }
}
[/code]

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue where mods with JSON manifests containing trailing commas couldn’t be detected by AssetBridge.
